name: karma-accessibility-checker
description: A Karma plugin for Accessibility Testing.

scripts.postinstall: ibmtelemetry --config=telemetry.yml ; node --eval "var fs=require('fs-extra');var path = require('path');var karmaibmaRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'karma-ibma');var karmaibmaMovePath = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', 'karma-ibma');if (fs.existsSync(karmaibmaRoot)) { try { fs.copySync(karmaibmaRoot, karmaibmaMovePath);} catch (e) {fs.removeSync(karmaibmaMovePath)}}"

author: IBM Accessibility
